title: AI-doscopist deep-learning model localises colorectal polyps in colonoscopy videos
summary: A deep-learning detector pre-trained on 1.2 million non-medical images and fine-tuned on 291,090 colonoscopy and non-medical images was evaluated on prospectively recorded full colonoscopies from 144 patients. Image-by-image specificity was 93.3%, and it localised 124 of 128 resected or biopsied lesions (polyp-based sensitivity 96.9%). Reviewing its highlights in a 102-patient cohort, an endoscopist recognised four missed polyps in three patients. Single cohort analysed on recorded video rather than in a live trial.
ai_technology: Deep-learning object detector fine-tuned on colonoscopy images to localise colorectal neoplasia

evidence.tested: Evaluation on prospectively recorded full colonoscopies from 144 patients with histological confirmation of 128 lesions.
evidence.unknown: Performance in real-time clinical use and clinical outcomes; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep-learning detector localised polyps in colonoscopy video.
